breakpoints.note: After the harness decodes the control bytes, Oniguruma accepts the exact 33-byte regex pattern for parse-tree construction. The crash occurs during compile-time tuning before any search on the trailing 4-byte subject string.
First project parser step that materializes the witness-controlled inner capture group `()` inside the positive look-behind as a `BAG_MEMORY` node and assigns it a capture number.

For this witness, `check_call_reference()` at `src/regcomp.c:5247-5254` has already loaded the capture into `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` and set `NODE_STATUS_ADD(..., REFERENCED)`, while the second pass never reaches `tune_call2_call()` because the enclosing `{0}` fails the `QUANT_(node)->upper != 0` gate in `tune_call2()`. The staged fix commit `5066ddb254b830bb583e62521ea7ac838f6df121` repairs this exact omission by changing the used-check to also accept `NODE_IS_REFERENCED(node)`.
